source.title: KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease
source.organization: Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD Work Group

duplicate_review.finding: No duplicate formal guidance atoms after semantic merge; repeated recommendation numbers across Recommendation and Practice Point namespaces were preserved as distinct source assertions.

consistency_review.finding: Formal recommendation strength/certainty is preserved in tags. Practice Points remain ungraded. Secondary study results were not promoted to primary-study results.

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom AtomKind enumeration has no dedicated guideline_recommendation or practice_point kind. Formal guideline statements were therefore serialized as atom_kind="other" with descriptive tags, per the large-source guideline guardrail.
extraction_limitations: Canonical statements were normalized from the PDF text layer to repair line-wrap hyphenation, ligatures, inequality symbols, and fused superscript citation numbers; assertion_origin is normalized_from_source.
The ATOM schema is oriented toward primary literature; this extraction captures the guideline’s formal assertions rather than reifying underlying trial evidence as primary-source atoms.
